in_sanskrit.name: प्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The prefix 'प्र' (pr) in Indian names often means 'before', 'in front of', or 'towards'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'प्रति' (prati) which means 'against', 'towards', 'in the presence of', 'in front of', or 'before'. It is a common prefix in many Sanskrit words and names.

in_hindi.name: प्रोनाब
in_hindi.meaning: प्र (pr) - before, नव (nav) - new, ब (b) - infant
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Pronab' can be broken down into 'Pra' and 'Nab'. The prefix 'Pra' in Indian names often means 'before', 'in front of', or 'towards'. The suffix 'Nab' could mean 'new' or 'infant' in various Indian languages.

in_tamil.name: பிரோனாப்
in_tamil.meaning: பிர் (pir) - before, ஓனா (onan) - new, ப் (p) - infant
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Pronab' can be broken down into 'Pra' and 'Nab'. The prefix 'Pra' in Indian names often means 'before', 'in front of', or 'towards'. in_telugu.name: ప్రోనాబ్
